His work, in constant evolution and transformation, emerges to surprise the viewer in all instances. services.name: Wine Tasting
services.desc: Join us for an evening of fine wine, gourmet bites, and community in support of Expressiones Cultural Center. Enjoy a guided tasting of six South American wines selected by wine expert Ken Turcotte (WSET Advanced Level 3, Certified Specialist of Wine). This special event will bring people together for a warm and engaging evening while helping Expressiones continue its mission of supporting Latin American and immigrant artists, youth programs, cultural exchange, and creative learning opportunities in New London.
